summary: Added slugify() to router/slug.py: lowercases, folds accents with unicodedata NFKD, collapses runs of non-alphanumerics to one hyphen and trims hyphens at both ends. The first attempt kept trailing hyphens; the retry fixed the trim. Added tests/test_slug.py covering accents, empty input, repeated separators and a 60-character limit.
concerns: The 60-character limit cuts mid-word; the task did not say whether to cut at a hyphen.
